title: R_TRIG: rising edge detection
summary: R_TRIG sets Q for exactly one call when CLK changes from FALSE to TRUE.

sections.heading: Behavior
sections.body: R_TRIG remembers the value of **CLK** from its previous call. **Q** is TRUE only in the call where CLK is TRUE and was FALSE before. Holding a button down therefore produces a single one-scan pulse.

sections.heading: Example: count button presses
Startup behavior
sections.body: In PLC Lab's generic profile the remembered value starts FALSE, so a CLK that is already TRUE in the first scan produces one rising edge. Platforms differ in startup handling; check your platform documentation.

outputs.name: Q
outputs.description: TRUE for one call on a FALSE-to-TRUE change

instruction.timing: Edge is relative to the previous call, not to wall time.
